name: v89_model_cashflow_certainty_contra
hypothesis: Cashflow-efficiency and earnings-certainty derivative scores were empirically contrarian in probes; value and open-close timing may turn them into a low-correlation model signal.
expression: 0.32 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative, 90)) + 0.28 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(earnings_certainty_rank_derivative, 90)) + 0.18 * rank(ts_rank(relative_valuation_rank_derivative, 90)) + 0.12 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)

name: v89_multifactor_accel_contra_value

expression: 0.34 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative, 90)) + 0.24 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(multi_factor_static_score_derivative, 90)) + 0.20 * rank(ts_rank(relative_valuation_rank_derivative, 90)) + 0.12 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
